title: Citrus Pie
description: A tangy and sweet pie made with a shortcrust pastry crust and a citrusy filling.

ingredients.name: Egg Replacer
ingredients.notes: such as flaxseed or chia seeds

instructions: Roll out the shortcrust pastry and place it in a pie dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the zesty citrus filling, lemon juice, sugar, and egg replacer.
Pour the filling into the pastry-lined pie dish.
Dot the top of the filling with the melted butter.
Bake the pie for 40-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Allow the pie to cool before serving.
